translations.web: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.
translations.bsb: From the city, men groan, and the souls of the wounded cry out, yet God charges no one with wrongdoing.
translations.kjv: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly
translations.asv: From out of the populous city men groan, And the soul of the wounded crieth out: Yet God regardeth not the folly.
